sources.title: Endocannabinoid signaling and synaptic function

sources.relevance: Core review: 2-AG vs AEA, CB1R signaling (βγ-VGCC short-term, αi-AC-PKA long-term), DSI/DSE mechanism, eCB-LTD types, spatial range 20μm, circuit coverage

sources.title: Endocannabinoid-mediated control of synaptic transmission
sources.authors: Kano M, Ohno-Shosaku T, Hashimotodani Y, Uchigashima M, Watanabe M
sources.note: Full text available via Atypon (subscription); only abstract read
sources.relevance: Authoritative comprehensive review; DGLα-KO evidence; PLCβ isoforms; evolutionary conservation of eCB system

sources.title: Control of synaptic function by endocannabinoid-mediated retrograde signaling
sources.journal: Proceedings of the Japan Academy, Series B, Physical and Biological Sciences
sources.relevance: Definitive DGLα-KO experiments; NAPE-PLD-KO shows AEA not needed for DSI; metaplasticity of eCB signaling (CaMKII→DGLα); stress effects

sources.title: A cortico-amygdala neural substrate for endocannabinoid modulation of fear extinction
sources.relevance: Key circuit paper: vmPFC→BLA eCB-LTD as mechanism of fear extinction learning; optogenetic activation accelerates extinction; CB1R blockade impairs extinction memory

sources.title: Anandamide-mediated modulation of nociceptive transmission at the spinal cord level
sources.relevance: Spinal cord dorsal horn: CB1R vs TRPV1 balance; inflammation shifts to CB1R dominance (73% inhibition); AEA precursor (NAPE) reduces nociceptive input

sources.note: Abstract available; PMC status uncertain; FSCV + optogenetics study
sources.relevance: eCB regulation of NAc dopamine via cortical CB1R and cholinergic interneurons; reward circuit mechanism

sources.title: Mechanisms of endocannabinoid transport in the brain
sources.relevance: AEA transport controversy: lipid diffusion vs protein-assisted (FABP, FLAT); in vivo evidence gaps
